entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling about an order. I need to return something, and I'm just so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. Just to be sure I have the right account, are you calling about the VeloFit Road Cycling Shoes?
Yes, that's them. I've been a loyal customer for years and I saved up for these. I just... they're not working out at all.
I understand. To make sure I get you to the right solution, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault with the product or more of a sizing and preference issue?
It's the fit. They just hurt my feet so much. I've tried everything, moving the cleats around, different socks... but I keep getting terrible blisters after every ride. I can't even use them anymore.

Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and I'm sorry you've had to deal with that. Let me just check your order details here. I see you received the cycling shoes 29 days ago.
I know, I tried for weeks to make them work. I really needed this money for other things, and now I have shoes I can't even wear. I was hoping I could still get a refund.

Of course. And the good news is, you absolutely can. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within that window. I can start the return process for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful news! Thank you so much, Alex. You have no idea what a relief that is. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. I'm glad I could help. I've just sent an email to the address on file with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive them, your refund will be processed.
That's perfect. Thank you again for being so helpful.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Have a great day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
